actions.name: Exploit CVE-2023-27350 to bypass authentication and access PaperCut server as administrator
actions.description: Malicious actors exploited CVE-2023-27350 beginning in mid-April 2023, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable PaperCut MF and NG servers by bypassing user authentication via the SetupCompleted Java class.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Execute remote code on PaperCut server using print scripting interface
actions.description: Actors leveraged the print scripting interface to execute shell commands on the compromised PaperCut server process pc-app.exe running with SYSTEM- or root-level privileges.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Execute remote code on PaperCut server using User/Group Sync interface
actions.description: Actors used the User/Group Sync interface to execute a living-off-the-land-style attack for remote code execution on vulnerable PaperCut servers.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Download and execute legitimate remote management and maintenance (RMM) software via PaperCut print scripting interface
actions.description: Bl00dy Ransomware Gang downloaded and executed legitimate RMM software on victim systems via commands issued through PaperCut’s print scripting interface.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Use external network communications through Tor and/or other proxies to mask malicious network traffic
actions.description: Bl00dy Gang ransomware actors used external network communications through Tor and/or other proxies from inside victim networks to mask their malicious network traffic.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: Download and execute command and control (C2) malware such as DiceLoader, TrueBot, and Cobalt Strike Beacons
actions.description: The FBI identified information relating to the download and execution of command and control (C2) malware such as DiceLoader, TrueBot, and Cobalt Strike Beacons during the attacks, although the exact stage of execution is unclear.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.
